turns.text: Hi Sofia! How is your Wednesday going at the outpatient clinic? Are you feeling completely back to 100% after recovering from the flu?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi! Yes, I'm feeling totally back to normal, thank goodness. The clinic is busy today, but I had a nice, relaxing commute this morning because I decided to ride the city's rail transit line instead of driving.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a much more peaceful way to start the morning. Did you have a chance to read or listen to anything during the ride?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I finally started listening to that real-life crime podcast my coworker recommended a while back. It definitely kept my attention the whole way there.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, is it as gripping as they promised?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, it's really well-produced and quite spooky! I actually kept listening to it during my break. Speaking of breaks, I had a really satisfying lunch today—I made a turkey and cheese sandwich using a couple of slices of my home-baked sourdough bread.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Yum, nothing beats a sandwich on homemade sourdough! How has your baking been going lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's been going well! I've been trying to keep my starter active and healthy. I shared some of my recent bakes with Tom, and he really enjoyed them.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's wonderful to hear. It's always great when others get to enjoy your baking. Have you two had any time for salsa dancing lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We haven't gone dancing in a bit, but it's always fun when we do. For now, I'm just focusing on getting through my shift.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That makes sense. Hopefully, the rest of your day at the clinic goes smoothly and quickly!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you! I'm just about to head back to the floor, but it was nice catching up. Talk to you later!
